title: Workflows
description: Tasks, approvals and the steps every order passes through.
arrives: The state machine behind every order, written by the area owner
SPR approval within limits, with a second approver where one is needed
The payment gate for prepayment orders
Reminders and escalations on a schedule

notice.mock: These screens read mock data. Approving, rejecting and confirming only check the request: nothing is saved until the workflow engine is built.

inbox.heading: Task inbox
inbox.ownDescription: The steps waiting on you, most urgent first.
inbox.otherDescription: You can look at any role's inbox. Pick one.
inbox.emptyDescription: Nothing needs this role right now. New tasks appear here as orders move.
inbox.noInboxTitle: Your role has no task inbox
inbox.noInboxDescription: Ask for the permission to open other roles' inboxes, or sign in as a role that has tasks.

reminders.heading: Reminders
reminders.description: What is due, who has been told, and where it goes if nobody acts.
reminders.emptyDescription: Reminders appear here when a task is close to its due date.

order.heading: Order {{orderNo}}
order.stepsDescription: Where the order is on its way. The state machine will decide the real status.
order.timelineEmpty: Nothing has happened to this order yet.
order.notFoundTitle: This order is not in the sample data
order.notFoundDescription: Check the order number, or go back to the task inbox.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.description: The prepayment asked for and what Finance has confirmed.

form.heading: Confirm a payment
form.invalid: Fill in every field. The amount must be more than zero.

spr.heading: Stock purchase request {{recordNo}}
spr.basisDescription: Available stock is Inventory, minus Qty. on Sales Order, plus Qty. on Purch. Order. The suggestion is the shortfall.
spr.fieldsDescription: Suggested values are the system's proposal. They are not final until you approve.
spr.approverDescription: From the approval setup, in the shape of Navision's Approval User Setup. Area 4 owns the limits.
spr.commentHint: Say why. The comment is kept with the decision.
spr.commentRequired: Write a comment before you decide.
spr.readOnly: Your role can read this request but not decide it.
spr.notFoundTitle: This request is not in the sample data
spr.notFoundDescription: Check the number, or go back to the task inbox.
